sites.current_operation: Writes ThreadRevision(status='booked') and an occupying Revision at state.preferred_day/preferred_time, then self.db.commit(). No advisory lock, no revalidation, no calendar check, no professional, no idempotency; under SB1 an overlap raises 23P01 inside CE.

command.attach: writes the booked ThreadRevision + lead/state updates + token consumption; returns the ThreadRevision

sb2b_rules: COMMITTED/IDEMPOTENT_REPLAY: keep the flow-txn:<ThreadRevision.id> acknowledgement keyed on result.thread_revision_id
SLOT_CONFLICT/CALENDAR_EXCEPTION: book nothing; call request_manual_scheduling so the human escalation survives
any other refusal: book nothing, acknowledge nothing as confirmed, hand off

sites.current_operation: Writes an OCCUPYING Revision (default PENDIENTE) at the time the customer insists on after CE judged it unavailable. invariants: the human escalation is preserved even when the requested slot is unavailable
